name: city-walks-workflow
description: Workflow for a hand-drawn walking map (the SF City Walks map at wallywalks.app): landmark pieces drawn from their survey, piece review with evidence bound to the sprite, people and walkers as map sprites, map repairs and a pre-audit check, a new-city pipeline, address autocomplete, shared-Chrome discipline, the test.wallywalks.app preview deploy, per-branch production deploys, and a Google sign-in checklist. Its hooks are tripwires, not containment.
